svg.title: Greedy choice of 12 batteries from the bank 818181911112111
svg.desc: For each of the 12 digits, the code searches a window that starts after the previous pick and leaves enough digits for the remaining picks, and takes the leftmost largest digit. The result is 888911112111.

g.text: Part 2: pick 12 digits, left to right
each pick = leftmost maximum inside the window that still leaves room for the rest
blue = search window · green = already picked
